item.tib: dz+wa this drag po'i bka' srung ma cig sgra bla'i rgyal mo'i mchod bskul
item.coloph: de ltar dz+wa this las kyi sdong mdzad la/ stag ri rong gi sgra bla'i bskul chung 'di/ bstan 'gro smin phyir brda' ris legs btab te/ zhang zhung gnas kyi sgo mo'i nye 'dabs su/ gter sbos srung ma rnams kyis bya ra gzob(gzobs)/ phyis su nges med sprul sku gshed bzhi los/ zab mo gter gyi sgo rnams 'gyed par shog phyis su spral ming thugs rje nyi mas phug leb 'o ma stag rtse nas rnyed de/ lo mang gsang rgya sdam (bsdams)/ slar dad slob nor bu rgya mtsho'i ngo skal du shog ser bod yig du (tu) phabs pa'o//
